detected_51_species_source_table: 51-species underground-organ resource triage table from the UGO-Omics broader species atlas
design_principle: UGO-Omics separates broad underground-organ resource coverage from high-confidence orthogroup-based analytical transfer.
why_11_species: The 11-species backbone was selected to balance underground-organ diversity, phylogenetic breadth, annotation completeness, and computational reliability for orthogroup-based candidate transfer.
why_not_all_51: All 51 species were not forced into the orthogroup backbone because heterogeneous genome/proteome completeness and annotation quality can introduce unstable orthogroup inference, false absence, and unreliable candidate-transfer signals.
role_of_51_species: The broader species atlas captures underground-organ diversity, resource availability, organ categories, phylogenetic context, and future expansion space.
role_of_11_species: The high-confidence backbone supports orthogroup construction, candidate-module transfer, UGO score calculation, and user-facing toolkit workflows.
